scenarioName: Cold start uses the LLM assistant suggestion
description: With no learned mapping (LearnerHound has not run yet) the planner falls back to the default LLM assistant for a search term, product hint and default weekly quantity.

input.userMessage: Plan 'quinoa' with an empty preferences file (cold start).

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON ShoppingPlan built from the assistant's cold-start suggestion at Normal priority.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: With no learned data the assistant's suggested search term and product hint must be used, at Normal priority.

scoring.passCriteria: Plan uses the assistant's search term and product hint and does not mark the item High.
